FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Store Manager, WonderWorld Toys, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: johnsmith@wonderworldtoys.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
WonderWorld Toys engages in the retail sale of a diverse range of toys for children of all ages. Our operations focus on providing a safe and enjoyable shopping environment, with an emphasis on customer service and product quality. We source our toys from reputable suppliers who adhere to necessary safety standards, ensuring that all products are compliant with regulations set forth by the Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). 

Our store implements rigorous inventory management practices to maintain well-documented controls and conduct regular stock audits. Additionally, we prioritize employee training on safety, product handling, and data security to mitigate any operational risks. Our staff undergoes safety training to handle our products effectively and assist customers with their inquiries.

We maintain a welcoming and organized store layout designed for positive customer experiences and easy navigation. Operating hours are aligned with peak shopping times to cater to our community's needs. WonderWorld Toys is dedicated to promoting safe play through responsible practices, ensuring our customers have access to the best toys while fostering a secure shopping atmosphere.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store manager, John Smith, checks the certificates to ensure compliance.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – WonderWorld Toys has not experienced any policy or coverage that was declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. All insurance policies have remained continuously active and compliant.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – WonderWorld Toys does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed by the store.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – WonderWorld Toys does not currently carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as we rely on a legal exemption due to having fewer than three employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – WonderWorld Toys does not own or operate any other business. It solely focuses on the retail sale of toys.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – WonderWorld Toys does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. The only active policy is WWT-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – WonderWorld Toys is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are solely focused on the retail sale of toys sourced from reputable suppliers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – WonderWorld Toys does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations strictly focus on the retail sale of toys. We maintain a safe environment for customers without engaging in equipment rental or loaning activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – WonderWorld Toys has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The financial history is stable and compliant, contributing to a secure operational environment.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – WonderWorld Toys does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations are solely focused on the retail sale of toys and comply with safety regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – WonderWorld Toys does not have any exposure to catastrophes as it operates solely in the retail sale of toys without engaging in high-risk activities or locations that would present such risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – WonderWorld Toys has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The store maintains a commitment to a safe and respectful environment for all customers and employees.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – WonderWorld Toys currently has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring a safe environment for customers and compliance with safety regulations.
